A.name: Live system
A.meaning: Read directly from a connected system (EHR/PM, clearinghouse, ERP, CLM, BI warehouse) through a connector, API or saved query.

B.name: Export file
B.meaning: A report someone exports on a schedule (CSV/XLSX) and drops in the readiness inputs folder. Validate the column mapping once.

C.name: Leader estimate
C.meaning: A structured estimate from the CFO, practice administrator or department lead, captured in a template with a named owner and date.

D.name: Public default
D.meaning: A public benchmark or national figure used until better data exists. Always labeled 'directional' in outputs.

dependencies.name: Payer mix by financial class (trailing 12 months)

tiers.A: EHR/PM or BI connector query: net revenue and visits by financial class, trailing 12 months, by month.
tiers.B: Practice management 'financial class summary' or 'payer mix' report exported monthly (names vary by system). Template: templates/payer_mix.csv.
tiers.C: CFO estimate of net revenue and percentage by payer class (Medicare FFS, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid FFS, Medicaid managed care, exchange, commercial, self-pay, other).
tiers.D: Segment default mix from segment-archetypes.md, adjusted with the state's coverage distribution from KFF State Health Facts. Directional only.

dependencies.validation: Net revenue by class should tie to the income statement within 3%. Visits should tie to the scheduling system within 2%.

dependencies.name: Medicaid patient roster with age and aid category

tiers.A: Eligibility responses (271) or PM coverage table with aid category, so expansion adults are identified exactly.
tiers.B: PM export of active Medicaid patients with date of birth and plan name. Proxy for expansion adults: ages 19 to 64, excluding plans or aid codes for pregnancy, disability (SSI) and children.
tiers.C: Count of active Medicaid patients ages 19 to 64 from the practice administrator.
tiers.D: National default: roughly 30% of Medicaid beneficiaries are subject to work requirements (Morgan Lewis, Nov 2026). Apply to the Medicaid share from D01.

dependencies.validation: Expansion-adult proxy count should be within 15% of a 50-chart manual spot check.

dependencies.name: Exchange (marketplace) plan patients

tiers.A: Product type field (individual/marketplace) in the PM coverage table.
tiers.B: PM export filtered on plan names that carry marketplace or metal-tier wording; confirm the list once with the billing lead.
tiers.C: Billing lead estimate of the share of commercial revenue from individual-market plans.
tiers.D: State marketplace enrollment as a share of state population (KFF) applied to the commercial share. Directional.

dependencies.validation: Plan-name list reviewed once by billing; re-review when new plans appear.

dependencies.name: Medicare Part B professional revenue by CPT

tiers.A: Claims or remittance (835) data by CPT and place of service.
tiers.B: PM 'CPT frequency by payer' export for Medicare, trailing 12 months.
tiers.C: Total Medicare Part B professional revenue from the income statement.
tiers.D: CMS public data: 'Medicare Physician & Other Practitioners - by Provider and Service' for the group's NPIs (lags about two years). Directional for trend, solid for mix.

dependencies.validation: Units times 2026 rates should land within 5% of reported Medicare professional revenue.

dependencies.name: Hospital outpatient services by site and APC

tiers.A: Hospital decision-support or claims warehouse by revenue code, HCPCS, APC and location (on-campus, off-campus excepted, off-campus non-excepted).
tiers.B: Chargemaster utilization report by department and location.
tiers.C: Service-line leader estimates of volume at off-campus departments for clinic visits, drug administration and imaging without contrast.
tiers.D: CMS OPPS and PFS rate files to price the site differential for any volume estimate.

dependencies.validation: Off-campus department list matches the provider-based attestation list.

dependencies.name: Commercial payer contracts

tiers.A: Contract lifecycle system or a connected drive folder of executed contracts, read by the agent.
tiers.B: Contract summary spreadsheet (templates/contracts.csv) maintained by managed care.
tiers.C: Email search for amendments, renewal letters and fee schedule notices, then a confirmed list from the CFO.
tiers.D: No public fallback. Ask each payer's provider relations representative for a contract summary and assume a 90-day notice window until confirmed.

dependencies.validation: Every contract with more than 2% of net revenue has a confirmed notice deadline.

dependencies.name: A/R aging, bad debt and charity by financial class

tiers.B: Month-end A/R aging by financial class export plus the bad debt and charity lines from the monthly close.
tiers.C: Monthly financial statement bad debt line and total A/R from the controller.
tiers.D: Kaufman Hall National Hospital Flash Report trend (bad debt and charity per calendar day) as an external comparison. Directional for non-hospitals.

dependencies.validation: Total A/R ties to the balance sheet.

dependencies.name: Point-of-service collections and estimates

tiers.A: PM daily close or payment platform connector.
tiers.C: Front-desk manager weekly log in templates/pos_log.csv.
tiers.D: None. Start a log; two weeks of data beats any benchmark.

dependencies.validation: Collected at service ties to deposits.

dependencies.name: E/M and procedure code distribution by rendering provider

tiers.A: Claims warehouse query by rendering NPI, month and CPT.
tiers.B: PM 'CPT frequency by provider' export for a baseline period (before AI documentation tools) and the current period. Template: templates/em_codes.csv.
tiers.C: Coding manager's sample of recent encounters by level.
tiers.D: CMS public Medicare data by NPI and HCPCS for each provider (lagged) plus specialty-level distributions as the benchmark.

dependencies.validation: Code counts per provider tie to visit counts within 2%.

dependencies.name: Denials by reason code

tiers.A: Clearinghouse denial analytics (835 CARC/RARC) via connector.
tiers.B: Clearinghouse or PM denial report export.
tiers.C: Billing lead's monthly count of eligibility and coding denials.
tiers.D: None. Start tracking CARC 26, 27 and 31 (coverage) and coding-related denials now.

dependencies.validation: Denied claims count ties to the remittance totals.

dependencies.name: Vendors with PHI access, BAAs and cash-criticality

tiers.A: Vendor risk platform or IT asset inventory connector.
tiers.B: Accounts payable vendor list joined to the BAA folder index. Template: templates/vendors.csv.
tiers.C: CIO and practice administrator workshop listing systems that touch PHI or cash.
tiers.D: The function checklist in vendor-resilience (clearinghouse, PM/EHR, eligibility, payment processing, patient statements, transcription, AI scribe, cloud backup).

dependencies.validation: Every system with a login that shows patient data appears on the list.

dependencies.name: State footprint, entity structure and deal pipeline

tiers.A: Entity management system or legal team tracker.
tiers.B: Org chart and entity list from counsel or the controller.
tiers.D: State lists in reference/state-rules.md. Always confirm with counsel.

dependencies.validation: Counsel confirms the entity list once a year.

dependencies.name: Medicaid supplemental payments: provider tax, state-directed payments, DSH

tiers.A: Hospital reimbursement or cost report system.
tiers.B: Finance's supplemental payment schedule by program.
tiers.C: CFO estimate of annual supplemental payments by program.
tiers.D: State hospital association briefings and KFF/MACPAC state tables. Directional.

dependencies.validation: Ties to the Medicaid supplemental lines in the audited financials.

dependencies.name: Workforce: vacancies, agency and locum spend

tiers.B: Monthly HR vacancy report and AP agency invoices.
tiers.D: HRSA workforce projections (10% RN shortage in 2027, 24% non-metro) as context only.

dependencies.name: Policy and market intelligence

tiers.A: Web search plus CMS, Federal Register, KFF and state Medicaid agency pages, scored with source-scoring.md.
tiers.B: Newsletters forwarded to a connected inbox and read by the agent.
tiers.D: The regulatory calendar in this plugin, which is static until refreshed.

dependencies.validation: Every change that moves an assumption cites a source scored 4 or higher, or two sources scored 3.

dependencies.name: Upcoming appointment schedule with coverage on file

tiers.A: Scheduling connector or nightly appointment extract.
tiers.B: Daily or weekly appointment export with insurance columns.
tiers.C: Front-desk lead pulls the next week's Medicaid appointments manually.

dependencies.name: Real-time eligibility verification capability

tiers.A: Batch 270/271 eligibility through the clearinghouse 48 to 72 hours before visits, returning aid category.
tiers.B: Real-time eligibility at check-in through the PM or payer portal.
tiers.C: State Medicaid provider portal lookups by staff.
tiers.D: Patient-presented card plus attestation at check-in. Highest risk; escalate.

dependencies.validation: Spot-check 20 verifications a month against the state portal.

dependencies.name: Agent infrastructure: state store, delivery channel, scheduler

tiers.A: Scheduled tasks in Claude with a connected folder or cloud drive as the state store, and email or chat as the delivery channel.
tiers.B: Headless agent on a schedule (cron with claude -p, or a GitHub Actions workflow) writing to a private repo or shared drive.
tiers.C: Calendar reminders (.ics) that tell the leader to open the agent and run the skill by name.
tiers.D: A printed or shared action calendar with the same dates.

dependencies.validation: First scheduled run produces its output in the state store and reaches the delivery channel.
